fm.leave.title: Leave without saving?
fm.leave.body: Your changes here haven't been saved. If you leave now, they are lost.
fm.leave.fix: This can't be saved yet: fix the fields marked below first.
fm.pw.title: Leave without the passwords?
fm.pw.body: These passwords are shown only once, and they haven't been printed or downloaded yet. If you leave now, each person's password has to be reset.
fm.pw.fileHint: The file contains everyone's password: keep it somewhere safe, and delete it once people have signed in.
fm.pw.csvInstead: The Excel file couldn't be made, so a CSV file with the same logins and passwords was downloaded instead. Excel opens it.
fm.cantRead: This file couldn't be opened. Check your connection, save the file again as .xlsx or .csv, then try once more.
fm.ann.leaveBody: What you wrote isn't saved anywhere. If you leave now, it is lost.
fm.ann.sendBody: It goes to their phones now, in English and in Arabic. A sent announcement can't be taken back.
fm.sw.offTitle: Turn Darsi Super off for everyone?
fm.sw.offBody: Super is hidden everywhere, the tutor stops answering and nothing can be bought until you turn it on again. Subscriptions and credits are kept.
fm.num.price: Enter a price above 0 and at most {max}, or leave it empty.
fm.num.credits: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
fm.marginLow: {cur}: {pct} margin. That is below the {least} minimum, so this price can't be saved.
fm.fill.soFar: Seats given so far: {n}. Still going…
fm.fill.none: No seat was given: every seat is taken, or nobody is waiting for one.
fm.fill.more: Seats given: {n}. Some people are still waiting and seats are still free: press “Give the free seats” again to go on.
fm.reset.hint: Download or print these now: the new passwords are shown only once, and the old ones no longer work.
